mainEntity.name: Are your boxing technique training classes suitable for children or teenagers?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Cave Training, our boxing technique training classes are primarily designed for adults. However, older teenagers with appropriate maturity and physical development may be able to participate, depending on individual assessment. A decision factor for parents or guardians is to consider the individual's physical readiness and ability to follow complex instructions safely in a group setting. It's recommended to discuss with our staff if you are considering enrolling a teenager to ensure the class environment is appropriate for their age and skill level. For younger children, specialized youth programs might be more suitable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our boxing technique classes are primarily for adults, though older teenagers might participate based on individual assessment. It's a decision factor for parents to discuss their teen's readiness with our staff.
